title: AI Data Lead
description:
Data-AI Lead
About Us
OurRitual is a fast-growing digital platform reshaping how relationship therapy works. We combine expert-led therapy sessions with AI-powered support to create a blended experience - where clinical depth and intelligent technology weave together into something neither could deliver alone. We call it Continuous Therapy. We've reached product-market fit with strong growth, exceptional engagement, and retention that breaks the category. We're pre-Series A, at the stage where AI moves from feature to foundation - and that shift runs straight through data.
Role Overview
As Data Lead, you will own how data gets turned into decisions across the company - and lead the shift from traditional BI into AI-driven BI, powered by agents that surface insight in real time. You'll work closely with one data engineer today, with room to grow the team as scope expands.
You'll define what the data function looks like when AI is embedded in it, not bolted on - from the underlying infrastructure to the dashboards and agents people actually use. The playbook for AI-native BI is still being written, and you'll write a lot of it.
Key Responsibilities
Data Strategy & Ownership

• Own the vision and roadmap for the data function, including the shift from classic BI to agent-based, AI-driven BI

• Set priorities in partnership with senior leadership

• Work closely with a data engineer today, with the option to grow the team as the function scales

AI-Driven BI & Agents

• Drive adoption of AI across data workflows - from automating analyses to agents answering business questions in real time

• Own the semantic and metrics layer so every dashboard and every agent reads the same definitions

• Build in a git-based workflow: dashboards and queries live in git, edited through PRs, built with agents

• Expose our data to agents over MCP so business questions get answered without waiting for a dashboard

• Define where AI speeds things up - and where human judgment still has to hold the line

Infrastructure & Analytics

• Own the data infrastructure: BigQuery, dbt, pipelines, and data reliability

• Lead complex analytics work, A/B testing, and impact measurement, hands-on

• Define evals and quality metrics for AI features and agents - not just A/B tests on dashboards

Cross-functional Collaboration

• Partner with product, marketing, finance, operations, and engineering to define analytical needs and turn them into solutions

• Represent the data function to the organization - senior-level storytelling with data

Skills & Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience in data roles, spanning both analytics and infrastructure

• Strong analytical foundation - you understand what makes analysis rigorous, not just what makes it automatable, and can use that to build an AI-driven analytics system that's actually trustworthy

• Hands-on experience integrating AI into data workflows - building it, not just using it; you've shipped an agent or AI analysis flow that people actually use

• Strong SQL skills and experience building scalable data infrastructure

• Track record owning data projects independently with stakeholders across the business

• Solid grounding in experimentation and statistical methods

• Excellent communication and presentation skills at a leadership level

• Comfortable being the most senior (and often only) data voice in the room

Nice-to-Have Skills

• Experience with dbt

• Experience with Amplitude

• Experience with BigQuery

• Experience with git-based BI workflows or tools like Modus

• B2C environment experience

Why This Role
Data teams are about to look very different - not because dashboards disappear, but because people expect answers faster than a weekly report can deliver. This is a rare opportunity to define what AI-native data leadership looks like at a company sitting on a dataset that doesn't exist anywhere else, with real ownership over how the function grows. title: Account Executive, Post-Acute Care
description:
About Aidin

Hi, we're Aidin ! We're here to create solutions for healthcare’s biggest challenges. Instead of waiting for someone else to step up, we rolled up our sleeves and created a better way to connect patients, payers, and care providers.
We are on a mission to defragment the healthcare ecosystem with a seamless digital platform that transforms healthcare for good and improves outcomes for all.
What We Do
Aidin is a dynamic healthcare technology company dedicated to revolutionizing care coordination and post-acute care transitions. Our innovative platform empowers healthcare organizations to streamline workflows, reduce costs, and ensure patients receive the highest quality post-acute care. You can learn more about us at www.my Aidin .com.
About The Opportunity
Aidin is looking for a growth-focused Account Executive, Post-Acute Care to manage a portfolio of existing post-acute care (PAC) clients while driving net-new business in smaller accounts. This is a revenue-carrying role focused on expansion and growth - you'll upsell current clients, land new logos, and consistently hit or exceed quota.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives in both relationship management and consultative selling - comfortable farming accounts but also motivated to hunt new opportunities. Our distributed team works 100% remotely on U.S. Eastern or Central time.
What You Will Do

• Prospect and close net-new business with regional PAC providers (SNFs, home health, hospice, IRF, referral partners)

• Run full sales cycles: discovery, demo, proposal, negotiation, and close

• Drive annual expansion within your existing account base through upsells and additional facility growth

• Use Aidin 's performance data and market reports to lead consultative, insight-driven conversations

• Deliver tailored demos that speak directly to PAC workflows, intake challenges, and executive priorities

• Articulate ROI - referral growth, census impact, competitive positioning - in terms healthcare decision-makers care about

• Own the onboarding experience for newly signed accounts and serve as the primary point of contact during the critical first 90 days

• Train users and administrators on Aidin 's reporting tools and how to act on data to drive referral improvement

• Manage an ongoing portfolio of regional accounts - monitor health, address issues proactively, and build lasting relationships

• Own the full renewal cycle: start conversations early, reinforce value, and close on time

• Maintain accurate pipeline, account records, and forecasts in HubSpot

• Feed market and client insights back to leadership to inform product and strategy

Skills & Qualifications

• 2-4 years of experience in account management or sales in healthcare SaaS within post-acute care, hospital/health system, senior care, home health

• Proven track record of hitting or exceeding quota through upsells and new logo acquisition

• Strong negotiation and presentation skills with the ability to engage executives

• Experience running both renewal/expansion cycles and net-new business sales cycles

• CRM experience required (HubSpot preferred); proven ability to run product demos and close business independently

• Strong organization and follow-through - you can manage a portfolio without dropping the ball

• Must be a self starter and “comfortable with the uncomfortable”; experience with another early-stage startup a major bonus

• Coachability is critical to the success

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Culture and Values
At Aidin , our team is guided by four core values that shape everything we do:

• Lead, Do Not React: Think big-picture, long-term, and do the right thing. We want team members who take initiative and lead with vision, rather than simply reacting to circumstances

• Make a Difference: For us, outcomes are everything. Be the solution. We value making a tangible impact through every event and initiative

title: Manager, Trade Promotion Management
description:
Confido is the AI infrastructure powering modern CPG - the platform that 200+ brands like OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Dr. Squatch, and Tropicana use to run everything from deductions to production planning. Finance, accounting, sales, and operations, unified in one system for the first time.

We're growing 5x year over year with a small team in New York City; the people who join now will shape the product, the culture, and the company itself.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere - and outsized ownership while you build - we'd love to meet you.

THE ROLE

We're hiring a TPM Manager to own the sales forecasting, trade planning, and trade optimization experience for our customers. TPM sit at the center of what Confido automates for CPG brands, and this role is the connective tissue between our Sales, Implementation, Customer Success, and Product teams - making sure customers actually resolve trade faster and more accurately on our platform, not just process them.

You'll work hands-on with customer sales forecasting and trade plans to help new customers get their TPM workflows configured correctly during onboarding, and be the expert voice that tells Product where the platform's TPM logic needs to evolve.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Product & Engineering

- Own the trade promotion management roadmap in partnership with Product and Engineering, prioritizing based on what brands actually need to plan, execute, and reconcile trade spend

- Translate trade planning processes - sales forecasting, promotion planning, promotion optimization, financial reconciliation, and ROI reporting - into clear, buildable product requirements

- Synthesize customer feedback, identify trends, and competitive intelligence into a prioritized set of product bets

Customer Success

- Lead discovery and design sessions with customer trade, sales, and finance teams to map how they plan and execute trade spend today, and how it should work on Confido

- Guide customers through TPM implementation - configuring promotion calendars, accrual rules, and deduction-matching logic - and train teams on how to run their trade spend operations in Confido

- Build the playbooks, SOPs, and internal training that let Sales, Implementation, and Customer Success teams operate without you in the room - your expertise should scale, not bottleneck

Go-to-Market

- Be Confido's voice on trade promotion management with customers, prospects, partners, and at industry events

- Partner with Sales and Marketing on discovery calls, deal support, and content that speaks credibly to trade, finance, and sales-ops audiences

- Track how brands, retailers, and distributors are evolving their trade spend practices, and turn those shifts into competitive positioning and battlecards for the broader team

- Build direct relationships with the retailers, brokers, and industry bodies that shape how trade programs get structured and reported

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

5+ years of hands-on trade planning experience at CPG brands, including direct responsibility for planning baselines and trade, executing plans, and reconciling trade yourself - extra points if you have implemented TPM systems

Fluency in the trade mechanics such as baseline planning, trade promotion types, rate base vs lump sum planning, accruals, off-invoice vs. bill-back, and how trade spend rolls up to gross-to-net revenue

A track record of turning operational expertise into product requirements, and comfort working directly with Engineering

Strong customer-facing instincts - you can run a discovery session, defend a design decision, and de-escalate an angry VP of Trade in the same week

Experience representing a product or point of view externally (webinars, conferences, analyst conversations)

 
 

🌴 PERKS + BENEFITS

- Equity - own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build

- Fully paid health coverage through Aetna - we cover 100% of employee premiums

- Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian

- Carrot F

title: Wireless Regulatory Engineer - SAR
description:
WIRELESS REGULATORY ENGINEER - SAR

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Consumer Devices team at OpenAI builds products that bring advanced AI capabilities into thoughtfully designed consumer experiences. We work across hardware, software, design, and research to develop reliable products from early exploration through production.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Wireless Regulatory Engineer to support RF exposure compliance for consumer hardware. You’ll work closely with RF, antenna, hardware, software, and regulatory teams throughout the product development lifecycle, helping ensure products meet applicable requirements while maintaining a high bar for performance and user experience.

This role is based in Mountain View, CA. We use a hybrid work model of four days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Develop and execute RF exposure test and validation strategies for consumer wireless products.

- Partner with engineering teams to evaluate product designs and identify potential compliance risks throughout development.

- Perform and analyze RF exposure measurements and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional teams.

- Support product development from early prototypes through validation, certification, and production.

- Coordinate testing with external laboratories and review results and supporting documentation.

- Translate applicable regulatory requirements into practical engineering guidance.

- Partner with RF and antenna teams to balance regulatory requirements with product performance.

- Develop tools and workflows that improve testing efficiency, consistency, and data analysis.

- Investigate issues, identify root causes, and work with engineering teams to develop effective solutions.

- Support global regulatory certification activities for wireless consumer products.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Have a Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, RF Engineering, or a related technical field.

- Bring deep experience with SAR, RF exposure, or wireless regulatory testing.

- Have a strong understanding of RF fundamentals, measurement techniques, and wireless systems.

- Have experience translating regulatory requirements into engineering and product decisions.

- Are comfortable performing hands-on testing, analyzing complex measurement data, and troubleshooting hardware systems.

- Have experience working with external test laboratories and supporting product certification.

- Collaborate effectively across RF, antenna, hardware, software, manufacturing, and operations teams.

- Are comfortable working in fast-moving, ambiguous product development environments.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

title: Scrum Master
description:
What is the position?

As a Scrum Master, you love contributing to the in-depth growth of development teams brought together for our clients. You will focus on the agile process of the team, support this process by making it more efficient and improving collaboration. In a nutshell, your most important task is to facilitate a good development process of the team. You enthuse the team to follow specific methodologies and solve any roadblocks the team encounters within their process. You also coach the team in their agile abilities and answer any process related questions from both the team as well as other stakeholders.

What are you going to do?

You will be part of a young and growing organization that aims to develop the best cross-platform mobile apps out there. As a Scrum Master, you’ll be responsible for creating a team spirit within a group of developers. You’ll act as a link between our developers, clients and third parties and keep the focus on the end goal. In addition, you’ll ensure that you will keep an open attitude but remain critical to make sure requirements are met for the customer while keeping everyone informed on project progress, status, schedule, deadlines, and releases.

You’ll be transparent and open about the choices made and to be made. You’ll know the ins and outs of the market and translate this into user stories. You’ll also be realistic and pragmatic and willing to cooperate.

Who are we looking for?

For this position, we are looking for someone who has very strong communication skills, experience with a role as a Scrum Master in an Agile work environment and an interest in the world of app development.

Ideally, you have some (Xamaring, C#, .NET) programming experience and you have at least two years’ experience in a comparable position. A PSM II certification is a big plus! You should also be aware of the ins and outs of the market and be able to translate this to user stories. Last but not least, you have a completed Masters Degree or equivalent.

Who is XABLU?

XABLU is a leader in cross-platform mobile app development and consultancy. From boosting our clients’ development teams to helping them refine their mobile strategy: we are there to support them with all of their app development needs. In addition, we host events where developers can talk about technology, hack and socialize. We are known for our deep expertise in the Microsoft Xamarin mobile ecosystem as well as our signature friendly and efficient team approach.

We also have internal projects we are developing: one is a user-centered platform combined with blockchain, and the other is a platform with a lot of automation challenges!

XABLU is a remote-first company: team and communication are our top priority and we embrace different cultures as well as different geo-locations. At XABLU, you’ll be working in an environment where you can express your talents, ideas and personality. You’ll be pushed by your colleagues to develop yourself and the team in an informal and fun atmosphere.

Your Profile

• Experience with a role as Scrum Master

• Strong communication skills

• Interest in app development

• Enjoy managing people and projects

• Good at prioritizing and planning

• Ideally, programming experience

• Completed Master Degree or equivalent

• Prefarably having PSM II certification or willing to obtain it

• Used to working with a team and to build up dynamics

• Available for 32-40 hours per week

Job Description: Sr. Medical Transcriptionist/ Medical Scribe (Full Time) (Night Shift)
We are currently seeking experienced candidates to join our team as Sr. Medical Transcriptionists/Medical Scribes in a full-time position with night shift hours. This role involves working closely with leading radiologists in the USA, transcribing live and offline dictations across different modalities such as X-ray, CT, Ultrasound, and more. The primary responsibility is to accurately transcribe dictations, prepare reports, and assist radiologists in completing error-free reports.
Key Responsibilities:

• Transcribe dictations: Listen to radiology dictations and accurately transcribe them into written reports, ensuring precision and clarity in the documentation of medical information.

• Collaborate with Radiologists: Work alongside radiologists in a live environment, assisting them during procedures and documenting findings in real-time.

• Offline transcription: Transcribe dictations from audio recordings outside of live settings, taking full responsibility for delivering accurate and timely transcriptions.

• Prepare reports: Utilize transcribed information to prepare concise and comprehensive reports, maintaining formatting and adhering to specific guidelines.

• Maintain speed and accuracy: Demonstrate excellent typing skills with a minimum speed of 30 words per minute (WPM) to ensure efficiency in transcribing dictations and report generation.

• Night shift availability: Exhibit flexibility and willingness to work night shifts in alignment with our operations.

• Strong communication skills: Possess effective written and spoken communication skills to collaborate with radiologists and other team members, ensuring clear and accurate documentation.

• Basic computer skills: Utilize computers and relevant software systems efficiently to manage and organize medical records, transcriptions, and reports.

• Ability to work as a team: Collaborate effectively with the healthcare team, supporting and assisting colleagues to ensure smooth and error-free operations.

• Continuous learning: Show enthusiasm for learning and adapting to evolving technologies, medical procedures, and guidelines.

Requirements:

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in Medical Transcription.

• Medical transcription certification or prior experience in the field is highly desirable.

• Good communication skills, both written and spoken, to effectively interact with radiologists and team members.

• Strong listening skills to accurately transcribe dictations and capture essential details.

• Typing speed of over 30 words per minute (WPM).

• Comfortable working night shifts in alignment with our operational requirements.

• Basic computer skills, including proficiency in relevant software applications for documentation and record management.

• Demonstrated ability to work well in a team environment and contribute collaboratively.

• Immediate availability for joining.

• Virtual interview process will be conducted.

If you possess a minimum of 2 years of experience in Medical Transcription, have excellent communication and listening skills, and are ready to work night shifts, we encourage you to apply for this challenging and rewarding position. You enjoy winning. Properly.

Publish the architecture, including the tradeoffs that were rejected and why.

•

Establish a governed way for agents to discover and call business capabilities, data, and tools, using the Model Context Protocol as the integration layer. Define an identity and authorization model that treats an agent as a first-class actor with its own least-privilege entitlements, along with observability, evaluation, and cost controls that work consistently for every agent. Set policy on what an agent may decide independently versus what stays with a person, and define where that line moves and on what evidence. Design the architecture to produce an examiner-ready record of what each agent saw, recommended, and touched, and set the evaluation and adversarial testing approach that makes agent outcomes defensible. Ensure the same foundation and controls apply to agents built by outside firms on the company's behalf.

•

title: Staff Product Manager, Core Primitives

We’re hiring a Staff Product Manager, Core Primitives, to own strategy and roadmap for a focused Core Primitives charter. This role is not about shipping isolated features. You’ll partner with the product portfolio lead to align your charter with broader platform priorities, and with engineering and SDK leads to turn strategy into coherent behavior across Temporal’s server, APIs, SDKs, and Cloud experience.

In the first year, success means Core Primitives has a clear strategy, prioritized roadmap, and shipped improvements that reduce the custom patterns, operational burden, and production risk developers face when building with Temporal.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own the product strategy and roadmap for a focused Core Primitives charter

title: (Senior) Research Manager – Survey Data & Innovation (m/f/d)
description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters - keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Responsibilities

- Improve survey operations. Contribute to ongoing survey work and identify opportunities to improve our methods, tools, and processes.

- Explore new approaches to consumer data. Lead projects assessing ways to collect or produce consumer data beyond online surveys, including behavioral data integration, data fusion, and synthetic data. Weigh their limitations against their potential value for client use cases.

- Design and run pilots: Set clear objectives, test promising approaches, and make evidence-based recommendations about whether and how to use them.

- Apply AI to survey workflows. Identify where AI could improve data quality checks, survey production, or other processes. Test practical applications and help implement those that deliver measurable benefits.

- Track the market. Follow how competitors and other research providers are developing their methods, data sources, and technologies. Turn relevant developments into proposals we can evaluate or test.

- Turn findings into action. Present your conclusions clearly, invite challenge and discussion, and work with colleagues and stakeholders to put agreed improvements into practice.

Requirements

- A strong grounding in quantitative market research and hands-on experience with online surveys.

- Experience improving a research method, workflow, or data product, including assessing whether the change achieved its goals.

- Curiosity about emerging approaches, including AI, and the judgement to recognise both their potential and their limitations.

- The ability to assess new approaches independently, think critically about their fit and impact, and work with the team and management to shape methodological decisions.

- A collaborative approach to working with experienced colleagues and the ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly in English.

- Experience with Microsoft Excel (Advanced) and keyingress Survey Platform

 

For the Senior Research Manager level, we’re also looking for a track record of leading methodological change, setting priorities across multiple initiatives, and bringing stakeholders with you from evaluation through implementation.

 

What we offer

- Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

- Hybrid work and flex-time

- International team and social events

- Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

- Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

- Career & training opportunities

- Attractive locations and modern offices

- Mental health support with OpenUp

title: Ресерчер
description:

Працюємо у 30+ найбільших містах США та вже успішно реалізували понад 30 000 ремонтних проєктів.

Детальніше про компанію ти можеш дізнатися за посиланням . Ти ознайомишся з нашою метою, критеріями, перевагами, а також відео-відгуками про роботу в Supplax від наших співробітників.
Ми активно масштабуємо команду рекрутингу та шукаємо Talent Sourcer, який буде працювати з комерційними вакансіями та будувати сильну воронку кандидатів через різні канали пошуку.

Це роль для людини, яка любить системний сорсинг, працює з даними та хоче впливати не лише на пошук кандидатів, а й на стратегію сорсингу в компанії.
Ця роль для тебе, якщо ти:

• Не чекаєш поки кандидат прийде сам, а знаєш, де шукати справжні таланти;

• Boolean\X-Ray search- основний інструмент в твоїй роботі;

• Ти вмієш зацікавити кандидата з першого речення і не знаєш, що таке copy\paste;

• Ти не просто скролиш стрічку, а працюєш з цифрами, розумієш конверсію воронки та тестуєш гіпотези.

Твої задачі

• Працювати одночасно з 4-5 активними вакансіями (Sales / Digital / Operations напрямки).

• Щодня робити якісні персоналізовані контакти через LinkedIn та інші канали.

• Використовувати різні джерела пошуку: LinkedIn, Boolean/X-Ray search, AI-інструменти, професійні спільноти, job boards.

• Вносити всі дані по кандидатах у внутрішню ATS-систему компанії та підтримувати порядок у воронці.

• Проводити первинну оцінку кандидатів перед передачею рекрутеру.

• Брати участь у формуванні та покращенні стратегії сорсингу.

• Аналізувати ефективність каналів і підходів та пропонувати покращення.

Тобі точно підійде, якщо ти:

• Маєш 1+ рік досвіду в сорсингу або рекрутингу.

• Вмієш працювати з Boolean Search та X-Ray Search.

• Використовуєш AI-інструменти для пошуку та підвищення ефективності.

• Маєш англійську від рівня A2+ для роботи з кандидатами та платформами.

• Мислиш через метрики (response rate, conversion, швидкість наповнення воронки).

Що ти отримаєш, ставши частиною Supplax:

• Стабільний дохід в $: ставка (обговорюється на співбесіді) + бонуси за результативність.

• Зручний формат: 100% віддалена робота з будь-якої точки світу.

• Графік: Пн-Пт, 8-годинний робочий день. Субота та неділя - вихідні.

• Роботу з сучасною ATS-системою та AI-інструментами.

• 20 робочих днів відпустки + вихідні на основні свята США + 5 лікарняних;

• Менторство, підтримку керівника та живу командну культуру, де кожен має голос.

Якщо ці пункти про тебе - Supplax чекає саме на твій відгук! Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Healthy Housing Research & Policy Intern
description:

Temporary or Intern (Paid) (Fixed Term) Summary:
JOB SUMMARY Habitat for Humanity's Terwilliger Center for Innovation in Shelter seeks a graduate-level intern - MPH or MSc - to support Habitat's thematic work around healthy housing during the academic year, between 6- 8 months. The intern will contribute directly to an evidence base and a technical framework. This role will bolster the growing body of evidence that housing conditions are among the most powerful and modifiable social determinants of health outcomes. The intern will consolidate data and evidence around thermal comfort and heat-related illness, vector-borne disease and structural housing modifications, indoor air quality and respiratory health, climate resilience and disaster risk, and WASH integration that points to the contributions of housing conditions and health. Key Responsibilities:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES

• Conduct an evidence review across housing and health domains - synthesizing peer-reviewed literature and program learnings.

• Produce an annotated evidence map linking housing conditions to health outcomes

• Map the landscape of organizations working at the housing-health nexus

• Support the development of the theory of change with the evidence base and indicators for mapping change- how housing improvements lead to health outcomes, for whom, through what mechanisms

• Draft language that will consolidate into an organizational technical framework

• Produce a final learning product - a structured policy brief or evidence synthesis- in consultation with academic supervisor and the organization

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
Current enrollment as a student at an accredited college or university; pursuing a degree at the intersection of public health evidence and practice. Candidates pursuing their MPH (Master of Public Health); MSc Public Health; Health Policy; Environmental Health; Global Health; Urban Health and Implementation Science.

PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS

• Understands social determinants of health and population health frameworks

• Can read, evaluate, and synthesize peer-reviewed public health literature

• Understands evidence grading and can distinguish strong from weak claims

• Comfort with qualitative research methods - key informant interviews, surveys, synthesis

• Comfortable with the use of AI in supporting research gathering and data analysis

• Can turn academic evidence into clear, accessible practitioner language in English.

• Writes well for non-academic audiences - development practitioners, donors, NGO leaders

• Experience in communicating across cultures.

Hiring Range:

For paid interns in the US, the rate of pay is $17.00 per hour (undergraduate student) or $19.00 per hour (graduate student). HFHI offers its paid interns in the US with limited benefits, including retirement plan contributions.

About Us:

Habitat for Humanity, founded in 1976, is a global, Christian-based nonprofit organization that grew out of an intentionally multi-racial community in rural Georgia. Seeking to put God’s love into action, Habitat brings together people of all faiths and people of no faith to build homes, communities and hope. Working alongside each other, we help families and individuals build and improve places to call home and achieve the strength, stability and self-reliance they need to build better lives for themselves. Habitat seeks individuals who have a willingness to affirm these principles and values.

At Habitat for Humanity International , we are compelled by our Koinonia roots to put God’s love for all into action and pursue housing equity and opportunity by bringing all people together to build community and drive impact. We strive to build a culture rooted in learning, accountability and trust, attracting and retaining mission-driven talent reflective of the global communities we serve.

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Deepgram is looking for an Inbound & Outbound Sales Development Representative to drive new customers and revenue to our rapidly growing company. You will create sales opportunities for Deepgram as you share our mission with CTOs, VPs of Product, and CEOs. You are a critical component in Deepgram’s Revenue organization and will play a pivotal role in growing our top-line revenue to new heights!

 

What You'll Do

- Work with our Partnerships team, Account Executives, and your fellow SDRs to build a strong sales pipeline of new logos, striving to exceed quarterly sales targets

- Work closely with cross-functional teams (especially Sales Ops and Sales Engineers) to ensure sales effectiveness

- Have a depth of understanding regarding customer needs in the ASR space, competition, and Deepgram products to be able to fully articulate our value proposition

- Research companies to find new speech recognition use cases and opportunities in the market

You’ll Love This Role If You

- Value having leadership that has tenure and a track record of success

- Thrive working with A Players as cross-functional partners across GTM

- Understand the importance of selling a product that is market validated and can deliver on its technical promise

- Are passionate about what Deepgram is building and how we are changing what is possible with speech

- Are eager to launch your sales career towards enterprise sales

It’s Important to Us That You Have

- 1+ year of customer-facing work experience in SaaS

- Prior sales experience selling a technical product

- Dynamic written and verbal communication skills

- Empathy and a unique ability to understand customer needs

- Exceptional at prioritizing complex outreach schedules and managing high-frequency touchpoints

It Would Be Great If You Had

- Experience prospecting companies that fit an ideal customer profile and understanding their business

- Consistently overachieved against sales targets in past experiences

title: X Writer
description:
ABOUT DARKROOM

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an X writer to run our executive content program for two brands: Darkroom, our growth marketing agency, and Shadow, our AI commerce platform. Ad Age recently described us as "if Omnicom was rebuilt on AI." Our buyers, founders and operators, follow the conversation on X first, and our executives reach more of them than any company page. X is the main channel for this role. You'll also adapt the best of it for LinkedIn, where the same buyers make considered decisions.

You make our executives sound like themselves, consistently, every week. You interview them, write for them, plan what each of them posts, and edit until it reads like a person, not a brand. Team members who want to post get your help too.

This is a hybrid role based in New York City, hiring in the US only, or remote in New Jersey, Florida, or Texas. Working with a team in the EST Time Zone, and all business is conducted 100% in English.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- The Executive Content Program: Run it day to day across our executive team, so every account has a clear voice, a plan and a steady rhythm.

- Voice Interviews: Recorded interviews with executives that become posts close to their own words.

- Context Files: A living file for every executive: voice, expertise, stories and the lines they won't cross, built from calls, talks and interviews.

- Ghostwriting: Ideas, drafts, edits and approvals for executive posts and threads on X, end to end, plus the LinkedIn versions.

- The Executive Calendar: One calendar across all executive accounts. You decide who posts for each launch and keep topics from colliding.

- Launch Days: Coordinate executive posts around launches, webinars and events so the accounts reinforce each other.

- Formats: X posts, threads, replies and quote posts, short video clip scripts, and LinkedIn text posts and carousels repurposed from them, from talks and from appearances.

- Editing: Every draft gets a human edit. Marketing speak comes out; the person's voice stays in.

- Reading What Works: Track which topics, formats and voices reach our buyers on X and LinkedIn, and feed it back into the calendar.

YOU SHOULD APPLY IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU

- You have ghostwritten for founders or executives on X, and the posts sounded like them. Send links. LinkedIn samples are a plus.

- You understand B2B buyers making considered decisions.

- You know commerce and growth well enough to write about DTC, performance marketing, retention and AI tooling without a briefing.
